label.purpose: Category chips. Row roles use the same face at 1.6rem.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Opacity half of the load arrival.

motion.name: slide-in
motion.purpose: Translate half of the load arrival.

motion.purpose: Shared delay before the load arrival.

components.name: Text link
components.description: Dotted serif link used in prose and the footer.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--color-200, #5a5a5a); font-family: var(--font-serif, "Recoleta"), Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; text-decoration: underline dotted var(--color-200, #5a5a5a); text-underline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 6px; transition: color 200ms, text-decoration-color 200ms; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--color-100, #151515); text-decoration-color: var(--color-100, #151515); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-100, #151515); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Serif menu. The current route keeps a 16 by 2 pixel tick.
components.html: AboutProjectsSnippets
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; } .ds-navlink { position: relative; color: var(--color-200, #5a5a5a); font-family: var(--font-serif, "Recoleta"), Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; transition: background-color 100ms; } .ds-navlink::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: 0; width: 16px; height: 2px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-200, #5a5a5a); transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0); transition: transform 200ms; } .ds-navlink:hover::after { transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); } .ds-navlink:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--color-100, #151515); } .ds-navlink:active { background: var(--color-500, #f8f8f8); } .ds-navlink-active { color: var(--color-100, #151515); } .ds-navlink-active::after { background: var(--color-100, #151515); transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1); }

components.name: List row
components.description: A project, talk, or snippet. Hairline below, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-400, #e2e2e2); transition: transform 200ms; } .ds-row:hover { transform: translateX(6px); } .ds-row-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; } .ds-row h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-serif, "Recoleta"), Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-100, #151515); } .ds-row-header span { font-family: var(--font-serif, "Recoleta"), Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-200, #5a5a5a); } .ds-row p { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, "DM Sans"), sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: var(--color-200, #5a5a5a); }

components.name: Category chip
components.description: Snippet category. Ink fill, bright paper text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--color-100, #151515); color: var(--color-600, #fafafa); font-family: var(--font-serif, "Recoleta"), Georgia, serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Code block
components.description: Fenced snippet on the code-well ground.
components.css: .ds-code { margin: 0; color: var(--color-100, #151515); background: #eeeeee; padding: 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 15px; } .ds-code code { white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Inline code
components.description: A token inside a sentence, on the hairline ground.
components.css: .ds-prose { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, "DM Sans"), sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: var(--color-200, #5a5a5a); } .ds-inline-code { background: var(--color-400, #e2e2e2); color: var(--color-100, #151515); border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; }

narrative.overview:
The name is read off the site that is already shipping: a narrow paper column, serif names, and lists separated by hairlines. This file records that system.

The page is one column, 824px at most, on a near-white paper ground. Recoleta carries the name, the navigation, and every title. DM Sans carries the explanation. Ink sits just off pure black, and there is no second hue. Density is a typeset index: a short title, a lede, then rows.

Nothing lifts. Rules are 1px hairlines. Motion is an arrival, a fade and a short rise when the page loads, and it is removed when the visitor prefers reduced motion. After that the page is still, except a nav tick and a row that shifts 6px on hover from 768px up.
keyCharacteristics: Recoleta for names, DM Sans for prose

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Soft Ink is the only strong color. It marks the name, the active item, a stressed word, and the chip. A second hue is not part of this system.

rules.name: The Ten-Pixel Root Rule
rules.body: html font-size stays 10px. Rem tokens in this file assume that root. Changing it rescales the whole site.

rules.name: The Serif for Names Rule
rules.body: Recoleta carries identity: the name, navigation, titles, roles, and chips. DM Sans carries explanation. Do not swap them.

rules.name: The Paper Column Rule
rules.body: Readable content stays in the 824px column. Do not open a second content column or a full-bleed band.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces do not cast shadows. If a new element needs to separate, use a hairline or type, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Arrival Rule
rules.body: Each region fades and rises once on load (fade 900ms, slide 600ms, delay 10ms). prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes that entrance. Nothing else animates in.

dos: Do keep the page on Paper, write primary text in Soft Ink, and write secondary text in Graphite.
Do set names, navigation, and titles in Recoleta, and explanations in DM Sans.
Do keep the column at 824px and separate rows with a 1px Hairline.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion. The load fade and slide are the only entrance.
donts: Don't introduce a chromatic accent, a gradient, or a shadow.
Don't add a second display face. Recoleta is the only serif.
Don't treat 1rem as 16px. The root is 10px, so 1.6rem is 16px.
Don't wrap a list row in an elevated card. The row is the surface, and the hairline is the edge.
Don't add motion after arrival, beyond the nav tick and the 6px row shift from 768px up.
